fixed_assets.title: Fixed assets
fixed_assets.name: Name
fixed_assets.start_hint: Starting adds these asset classes, each linked to accounts in your chart. You can rename, change or archive them later.
fixed_assets.start_defaults: Each month, depreciation is prepared for you to review before it posts. You can change this in settings at any time.
fixed_assets.run_mode_hint: What happens on the run day each month.
fixed_assets.threshold_hint: Lines below this amount per unit are flagged as possible expenses. Leave it empty for no threshold.
fixed_assets.first_managed_period_hint: Lines dated before this month were handled before the register started and are not offered for registration.
fixed_assets.classes_hint: Click a value to change it. Archived classes keep their assets but are not offered for new ones.
fixed_assets.contributed_bill_hint: The account the contribution is credited to, usually owner's capital.
fixed_assets.kind_hint.opening: An asset you owned before this register started. Enter its cost and what was already depreciated. No journal is posted.
fixed_assets.kind_hint.contributed: An asset given to the business without a bill. Its cost is posted against the credit account you choose.
fixed_assets.kind_hint.physical: Track an asset without any figures. You can add its financial details later.
fixed_assets.empty_hint: Assets come from bill lines posted to an asset account, or you can add them by hand.
fixed_assets.register_hint: Every asset you own, newest first. Open one to see its figures, sources and movements.
fixed_assets.intake_hint: Bill and journal lines posted to an asset account that no asset has claimed yet.
fixed_assets.line_gone: This line is no longer waiting. It may already be registered.
fixed_assets.link_hint: Split this depreciation between the assets it belongs to. The amounts must add up to the line.
fixed_assets.no_active_assets: There are no active assets to link this to.
fixed_assets.reason_hint: Saved with the line so anyone can see why it was left out.
fixed_assets.below_threshold: This line is below the capitalisation threshold. It may be an expense.
fixed_assets.undo_hint: Reverses this asset's journals and returns its source lines to the list. Possible only while nothing else has happened to the asset.
fixed_assets.runs_hint: Monthly depreciation: {mode}, on day {day} of each month.
fixed_assets.runs_empty: No depreciation has run yet. Choose a month that has ended and review it.
fixed_assets.run_through_hint: Every month from the one after the last posted run through this month is posted, one journal per month.
fixed_assets.run_missing: There is no run for this month.
fixed_assets.month_posts_nothing: Nothing to post for this month.
fixed_assets.nothing_to_depreciate: Nothing to depreciate yet. Add or register an asset first.
fixed_assets.held_title: Assets held out of this run
fixed_assets.reverse_run_hint: Reverses this month's journal and the depreciation it put on each asset. Only the latest run can be reversed, while its month is open.
fixed_assets.action_hint.fix_account: The asset's depreciation or accumulated depreciation account no longer takes postings. Choose another on its class or the asset.
fixed_assets.action_hint.review_source: A journal this asset's figures came from was voided. Review it, then correct the asset.
fixed_assets.action_hint.enter_reading: A month has no units recorded. Record the reading below.
fixed_assets.action_hint.skip: A month is skipped. Withdraw the skip below when it should be depreciated.
fixed_assets.attention_hint: These assets post nothing until what holds them is cleared. The next run catches them up.
fixed_assets.skips_hint: A skipped month posts no depreciation for this asset. The next run after the skip is withdrawn catches it up.
fixed_assets.run_day_hint: The day of the month, 1 to 28, on which last month's run is prepared or posted.
fixed_assets.notice.ready.title: Depreciation ready to post
fixed_assets.notice.ready.body: Depreciation for {month} is ready to post: {total}.
fixed_assets.notice.paused.title: Automatic depreciation posting paused
fixed_assets.notice.paused.body: Automatic posting is paused because fixed assets was turned off. Post this run by hand to resume it.
fixed_assets.notice.no_user.title: Automatic depreciation posting needs a user
fixed_assets.notice.no_user.body: The user who chose automatic posting can no longer post journals. Choose another user by setting posting to automatic again.
fixed_assets.notice.attention.title: Assets held out of depreciation
fixed_assets.notice.attention.body: {count} assets are held out of depreciation until what holds them is cleared.
fixed_assets.notice.corrections.title: Corrections waiting
fixed_assets.notice.reviews.title: Impairment reviews due
fixed_assets.apply_correction_hint: Applying posts the correcting journals and updates the asset's figures. You can undo it afterwards.
fixed_assets.apply_to_assets_hint: Moves every active asset in {name} that still follows older settings to the class's current depreciation settings, as a change in estimate. Each asset gets its own correction, which can be undone.
fixed_assets.apply_to_assets_title: Apply the {name} settings to its assets
fixed_assets.classification_hint: A change in estimate applies from now on. An error restates the past. Choosing the other one needs a reason.
fixed_assets.correct_hint.error: Fixes a figure that was wrong from the start. Past depreciation is recalculated and the difference is posted on the posting date.
fixed_assets.correct_hint.estimate: Changes how the asset depreciates from the month you choose. Months already depreciated stay as they are.
fixed_assets.correction_closed: This correction is closed. Nothing more can be done with it.
fixed_assets.correction_posting_hint: Leave empty to post on the original date while its period is open, or today otherwise.
fixed_assets.corrections_card_hint: Changes to this asset's figures or settings after it was added, newest first.
fixed_assets.corrections_empty_hint: Open an asset and choose Correct to fix a figure or change how it depreciates.
fixed_assets.corrections_hint: Every change to an asset's figures or settings after it was added, newest first. Requested corrections wait here until someone applies them.
fixed_assets.effective_month_hint: The first month on the new settings. Leave empty for the first month not yet depreciated.
fixed_assets.immaterial_reason_hint: Needed only when the effect on earlier years goes through this year's profit and loss.
fixed_assets.link_source_hint: Adds an existing journal line to the asset's cost.
fixed_assets.maintenance_hint: Moves cost that was really maintenance out of the asset and into an expense account.
fixed_assets.override_reason_hint: Needed when you choose a classification other than the suggested one.
fixed_assets.ppa_hint: Error corrections posted in the year that change figures reported for earlier years.
fixed_assets.ppa_immaterial_hint: Effects on earlier years judged immaterial and posted through this year's profit and loss, with the reason given.
fixed_assets.prior_to_equity: The effect on earlier years is posted to retained earnings.
fixed_assets.prior_to_pl: The effect on earlier years is posted to this year's profit and loss: {reason}
fixed_assets.prior_years.profit_and_loss: Take to this year's profit and loss
fixed_assets.restated_title: Depreciation by year, reported and restated
fixed_assets.request_hint: Not ready to post? Save the change as a request so someone who can post journals reviews and applies it.
fixed_assets.undo_correction_hint: Reverses the correcting journals and restores the asset's earlier figures.
fixed_assets.withdraw_hint: Withdrawing discards the request. Nothing has been posted.
fixed_assets.param.switch_to_straight_li: Switch to straight line when it gives more
fixed_assets.dispose_hint: Record an asset that is scrapped, lost, donated or otherwise gone. Review shows the depreciation brought up to the disposal date, what leaves the books and the loss or gain.
fixed_assets.dispose_several_hint: Each asset below is disposed of in whole, with its own journal. To dispose of part of an asset, open it and choose Dispose.
fixed_assets.disposal_note_hint: Required when the reason is Other.
fixed_assets.quantity_disposed_hint: Leave blank to dispose of all {quantity}.
fixed_assets.percent_disposed_hint: Leave blank to dispose of the whole asset.
fixed_assets.undo_disposal_hint: Reverses the disposal journal and puts the asset back as it was. Possible while nothing has happened to the asset since and the disposal date is open.
fixed_assets.notice.sale_reversed.title: Sale of {number} reversed with invoice {invoice}
fixed_assets.notice.sale_reversed.body: {number} is in use again and waits on invoice {invoice}. Finalize the invoice to sell it, or cancel the sale from the asset.
fixed_assets.sell_hint: Review shows what the sale will post. Confirm creates a draft invoice for the asset; finalizing that invoice completes the sale.
fixed_assets.sale_price_hint: Before tax. You can add tax and other lines on the invoice.
fixed_assets.sale_draft_deleted_hint: The asset still waits on its sale. Make a new draft invoice for it, or cancel the sale.
fixed_assets.sale_pending_hint: Finalize invoice {invoice} to complete the sale. Until then the asset stays in use and depreciates.
fixed_assets.reissue_hint: Makes a new draft invoice for the sale, with the buyer and price it had.
fixed_assets.cancel_sale_hint: The asset stops waiting on a sale. A draft invoice that still carries it is voided.
fixed_assets.credit_sale_hint: Makes a draft credit note on the sale invoice. Finalizing it lowers the proceeds, or for a returned asset puts it back in use.
fixed_assets.credit_amount_hint: For part of the price, before tax. A returned asset credits all that is left.
fixed_assets.add_hint.improvement: An improvement adds to the asset's cost from its date. Leave the life blank to keep the asset's end date, or enter a new remaining life.
fixed_assets.add_hint.replacement: The new part becomes a component with its own life. The part it replaces leaves the books: pick it from the components, or estimate what it cost if it was never separate.
fixed_assets.add_hint.repair: Repairs and maintenance are expenses, not part of the asset's cost. Open the bill line in Register from bills and choose Maintenance to log it against this asset.
fixed_assets.add_date_hint: Blank uses the journal line's date.
fixed_assets.source_line_hint: Pick the bill or journal line that paid for it, or leave it and enter the amount and credit account.
fixed_assets.credit_account_hint: Only when no journal line is picked.
fixed_assets.life_hint.improvement: Blank keeps the asset's end date.
fixed_assets.life_hint.replacement: The new part depreciates over this life.
fixed_assets.replaced_component_hint: Pick the component the new part replaces. It leaves the books in full.
fixed_assets.old_part_estimate: Estimated cost of the old part
fixed_assets.old_part_estimate_hint: When the old part was never separate: its share of the asset's cost leaves the books.
fixed_assets.remeasure_hint.revaluation: Bring the asset to its fair value. Depreciation is brought up to the date first. An increase goes to the revaluation surplus after reversing any earlier loss in profit or loss; a decrease uses up the surplus first.
fixed_assets.remeasure_hint.impairment: Write the asset down to its recoverable amount. Depreciation is brought up to the date first. On a revalued asset the loss uses up its surplus first.
fixed_assets.remeasure_hint.impairment_r: Write an earlier impairment back up to the recoverable amount, never above what the asset would carry had it not been impaired.
fixed_assets.cost_model_hint: This asset's class uses the cost model. Assets in it are revalued all together, on one date.
fixed_assets.measurement_date_hint: Depreciation follows the new carrying amount from the next month.
fixed_assets.basis_hint: What the value rests on, for example a valuer's report or a market quote.
fixed_assets.remeasure.limit: Limit: carrying amount had it never been impaired
fixed_assets.revalue_class_hint.cost: {name} uses the cost model. Changing it to revaluation revalues all {count} assets in it on one date; from then on they are revalued together.
fixed_assets.revalue_class_hint.revaluat: Revalue all {count} assets in {name} on one date. Each needs a fair value.
fixed_assets.revalue_class_empty: No assets in use in this class
fixed_assets.revalue_class_missing: No fair value yet for {numbers}. Every asset in the class is revalued on the same date.
fixed_assets.shared_basis_hint: Used for every row whose own basis is blank.
fixed_assets.place_hint: {balance} is under construction. Allocate it to the assets it built; whatever is not allocated stays under construction.
fixed_assets.allocation_hint: Blank life uses the class's life. Rows left empty are ignored.
fixed_assets.components_hint: Parts registered with their own life. Each is depreciated, replaced or disposed of on its own.
fixed_assets.reviews_hint: An intangible asset with an indefinite life is reviewed for impairment every year.
fixed_assets.recoverable_amount_hint: Only when the review measured a recoverable amount.
fixed_assets.review_found_loss: Review recorded. The recoverable amount is below the carrying amount: review the impairment below and confirm it.
fixed_assets.reviews_due_hint: Indefinite-life intangibles due a review within 30 days, or overdue. Open an asset to record its review.
fixed_assets.reviews_due_count: {count} assets are due an impairment review.
fixed_assets.undo_latest_hint: Undoes the latest change on this asset ({change}), reversing its journals. Possible while nothing has been charged since and its date is in an open period. Anything older is corrected instead.
fixed_assets.keep_line_hint: The depreciation stays as booked and is not linked to any asset. The reconciliation lists it as noted, with this reason.
fixed_assets.action_hint.disposition_jou: Depreciation was booked by hand on this asset's account for the month. Link that journal line to the assets it covers, or keep it as booked, from Register from bills.
fixed_assets.first_period_hint: Fixed assets records depreciation and changes from this month on. Earlier figures come in as opening balances. Nothing is recorded until it is confirmed.
fixed_assets.first_period_from_depreciat: Depreciation was booked by hand to {account} up to {date}.
fixed_assets.first_period_from_today: There are no journals yet, so this month is suggested.
fixed_assets.recon_banner: Some amounts on the asset accounts are not yet in the register, or differ from it.
fixed_assets.recon_hint: The register against the ledger on each asset account, from the cutover {cutover}. Each difference shows its cause and what clears it.
fixed_assets.recon_errors: The register does not add up
fixed_assets.recon_rule.opening: Opening balance not in the register
fixed_assets.opening_hint: What the ledger and the register hold on each asset account at the cutover {cutover}. Record the opening journal or add the missing opening assets until the differences are zero, or keep them open.
fixed_assets.opening_state.kept_open: Opening balances are finished with their differences kept open.
fixed_assets.reports_hint: Each report opens for a period you choose, and prints or downloads as CSV.
fixed_assets.schedule_hint: Cost, accumulated depreciation and impairment per class and asset: where each stood when the period opened, what moved it, and where it closed. Depreciation the schedule plans for the period that no run has posted yet is shown on its own.
fixed_assets.register_report_hint: Every asset with its class, status and current figures. Figures show only to those who can see financial reports.
fixed_assets.depreciation_hint: Each month's depreciation posted per asset, the months skipped with their reason, and the forecast still to post. Newest month first.
fixed_assets.disposals_hint: Assets that left the books in the period: what they fetched, their carrying amount, the gain or loss, and the invoice, credit notes and journal behind each. Newest first.
